title: Finite commitment-and-causality constructor for a complete rebuttal narrative
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED. A fixed typed constructor separates located participants, reported allegations, source-endorsed rebuttals, temporal existence, introduced kinship and a later action. A small Phaedrus example is executable and yields a counterfactual consequence beyond the fitted fable.

design.distinctness: IDEA000397 supplies the complete fable relations but leaves the constructor executable only in prose. This proposal fixes a finite typed AST, explicit truth/commitment states, arities and a generated counterfactual record. It is unrelated to IDEA000398's rule species/correlative endings and IDEA000128's chamber-table morphism.

source.work: Phaedrus, Fabulae I.1, Lupus et Agnus, complete 15-line fable
source.limits: Digital Latin witness ancestry is uncollated; no medieval manuscript or Voynich source relation is claimed. The father allegation remains unverified.

finite_constructor.evaluation: ALLEGES is REPORTED and does not update world truth. REBUTS evaluates a claim from typed facts: an upstream-fouling claim fails when water flows from accused downstream participant to accuser; an earlier-offense claim fails when the alleged agent does not EXIST_AT the alleged time. DOES remains executable after REBUTS.

derived_trace: MUDDY_WATER: REPORTED, REBUTTED, not world-true under FLOW.
LAMB_VERBAL_OFFENSE: REPORTED, REBUTTED because LAMB did not exist at the alleged time.
FATHER_VERBAL_OFFENSE: REPORTED, UNVERIFIED; PARENT_OF does not prove the act.
KILL: COMPLETED despite both earlier rebuttals; outcome does not promote either allegation to truth.

design.observable_counterfactual: Generate the same typed record with FLOW reversed to LAMB_DRINKING_PLACE -> WOLF_DRINKING_PLACE. The constructor then no longer rejects the muddy-water allegation. Separately set LAMB_BIRTH earlier than SIX_MONTHS_BEFORE_NOW; the temporal rebuttal then disappears. The final DOES(KILL) remains a separate action in both variants. A flat true-event list, a rebuttal-blocks-action rule, or an outcome-implies-truth rule predicts a different result.
rivals: Every ALLEGES proposition is asserted world truth: predicts muddy water and the lamb's offense despite both typed rebuttals.
REBUTS blocks later DOES: predicts no killing, contrary to the source's completed unjust killing.
A completed DOES validates its prior ALLEGES: predicts the rejected charges become true, contrary to the moral.
FATHER is an alias for LAMB: erases the new parent relation and changes the third allegation's argument type.
design.smallest_discriminator: A held complete record with the same allegation/action inventory but reversed FLOW or changed EXISTS_AT must change only the corresponding rebuttal truth, while a completed action remains independent. The nearest flat-list and outcome-entails-truth rivals cannot make that selective change.
design.likely_failure: The source grammar may be historically irrelevant to the manuscript, and no independently owned target passage currently binds these constructors. The source's father allegation remains UNVERIFIED; treating it as a proven event would invalidate the account.

predecessors.retained: Complete Phaedrus content and commitment distinctions; this proposal adds an executable finite constructor and counterfactual trace.
Read complete source dossier; its rule-species/correlative mechanism is a different architecture.
GDT882 rank/scope stop remains; no ten-letter chamber morphism or table copy is reused.
Directed composition and whole-form context remain structural background, not meanings.

design.access: Existing route, source dossiers and registry only. No new target access, image, reserve, f84/f84r/f116v, decoder, experiment, ledger, route update or publication.
